title: Does the AI Reviewer Alleviate or Aggravate the Maintenance Burden? Evidence from GitHub Copilot Reviewer
abstract: arXiv:2611.22793v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This study examines how AI-based code reviewers reshape contribution behavior and maintenance dynamics in open-source software (OSS) communities. AI reviewers provide scalable, fast, and standardized evaluations. They reshape contributions as well as maintainers' workload. Leveraging the introduction of GitHub Copilot Reviewer on GitHub as a natural experiment in 2025, we investigate how AI review affects maintainers' workload and review efficiency as well as contribution behavior. We find that repository maintainers initially face a sharp increase in PR submissions and a higher review workload after the adoption of the AI reviewer. Over time, human contributions decline while the increase in bot-generated PRs is sustained. Interestingly, survival analysis reveals that AI reviewers increase review efficiency for human PR contributions, whereas bot PRs take longer to review and merge. translated_title: AI审查者是减轻还是加重维护负担？来自GitHub Copilot审查者的证据
translated_abstract: 本研究考察了基于AI的代码审查者如何重塑开源软件（OSS）社区中的贡献行为和维护动态。AI审查者提供可扩展、快速且标准化的评估，它们既重塑了贡献方式，也改变了维护者的工作量。本研究利用2025年GitHub Copilot审查者在GitHub上的引入作为自然实验，探讨了AI审查如何影响维护者的工作量、审查效率以及贡献行为。研究发现，在采用AI审查者之后，仓库维护者最初面临PR（拉取请求）提交数量的急剧增加和更高的审查工作量。随着时间推移，人类贡献逐渐下降，而机器人生成的PR的增加则持续存在。有趣的是，生存分析显示，AI审查者提高了人类PR贡献的审查效率，而机器人PR的审查和合并则需要更长时间。研究结果表明，尽管AI审查者增加了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究以GitHub Copilot审查者的引入作为自然实验，发现AI审查者短期内显著加重维护者的审查工作量，长期则导致人类贡献下降而机器人PR持续增加，且AI虽提高了人类PR的审查效率，但机器人PR的审查与合并耗时更长。
en_tdlr: Using the 2025 introduction of GitHub Copilot Reviewer as a natural experiment, this study finds that AI reviewers initially increase maintainers' review workload, drive human contributions to decline while bot-generated PRs persist, and improve review efficiency for human PRs while bot PRs take longer to review and merge.
